zh.title: 漢莎航空集團引進Starlink機上網路 首架將於8月19日上線
zh.summary: 漢莎航空集團推動Starlink機上網路，首架客機定於8月19日投入服務。
body: 漢莎航空集團（Lufthansa Group）於2026年8月10日確認，正在旗下所有合作航空公司逐步推廣Starlink低軌衛星高速度機上網路服務。首架選定改裝並配備此高速度衛星網路系統的A320neo客機，預計將於2026年8月19日正式投入營運，開啟該集團新一代機上網路連線服務的部署計畫。
根據漢莎航空集團公布的規劃，此項Starlink機上網路服務將免費提供給Miles & More會員以及Travel ID用戶使用。為了維持舒適且安靜的客艙環境，搭乘航班並使用Starlink網路的乘客必須遵守相關使用條款，包括在播放任何音訊或視訊內容時必須配戴耳機。此外，回應大多數受訪客戶的意願，乘客在機上不得進行語音通話、視訊通話或進行現場直播。

這項網路升級計畫將涵蓋漢莎航空集團旗下的多家航空公司，包括瑞士國際航空（SWISS）、奧地利航空（Austrian Airlines）、布魯塞爾航空（Brussels Airlines）、義大利航空（ITA Airways）、雪絨花航空（Edelweiss）、發現航空（Discover Airlines）、多洛米蒂航空（Air Dolomiti）、漢莎城市航空（Lufthansa City Airlines）以及歐洲之翼（Eurowings）。集團預計於2029年前，將旗下約850架飛機全面完成Starlink技術系統的裝設。
漢莎航空集團商務長Dieter Vranckx表示，該集團正將高速度網路服務打造成所有艙等與旗下所有航空公司旅程體驗中不可或缺的一環，這也是集團對尊榮服務的定義。此外，漢莎航空集團機上網路入口網站將繼續由Mastercard贊助，該企業先前已是FlyNet系統的合作夥伴。集團指出，漢莎航空集團將成為歐洲機隊規模最大的Starlink機上網路裝設航空集團。

en.title: Lufthansa Group to Roll Out Starlink Wi-Fi Fleetwide Starting August 19
en.summary: Lufthansa Group will begin deploying Starlink high-speed onboard Wi-Fi across its fleet from August 19.
body: Lufthansa Group officially confirmed on August 10, 2026, that it is rolling out Starlink high-speed Wi-Fi internet across all of its partner airlines over the next three years. Work on the installation of the low-Earth orbit satellite technology has already commenced, with a Lufthansa A320neo selected as the first aircraft scheduled to enter service equipped with the high-speed connectivity on August 19, 2026.

Under the terms confirmed by the airline group, the onboard Starlink connectivity will be available free of charge to Miles & More loyalty members and Travel ID users. However, passengers using the high-speed internet on flights must strictly comply with cabin usage rules. Users are required to wear headphones when playing audio and video content. To respect the preferences of surveyed passengers, users must also refrain from making voice or video calls and broadcasting live streams from the aircraft.

The multi-year fleet rollout will extend connectivity across aircraft operated by group members, including SWISS, Austrian Airlines, Brussels Airlines, ITA Airways, Edelweiss, Discover Airlines, Air Dolomiti, Lufthansa City Airlines, and Eurowings. Lufthansa Group aims to equip its entire active fleet of approximately 850 aircraft with Starlink hardware by 2029, positioning itself as the largest airline group in Europe to implement the technology across its operations.

Dieter Vranckx, Chief Commercial Officer of Lufthansa Group, highlighted that high-speed internet is becoming an essential component of the premium passenger experience across all travel classes and member airlines. The group confirmed that its onboard Wi-Fi portal will continue to be sponsored by Mastercard, which previously partnered with the airline on its legacy FlyNet platform.

zh.title: 阿聯酋航空回收A380與777零件 打造兵工廠隊徽雕塑
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空回收空中巴士A380與波音777零件；打造8英呎兵工廠隊徽雕塑
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，阿聯酋航空（Emirates）將空中巴士（Airbus）A380 與波音（Boeing）777 退役客機零件進行回收，製作成一座8英呎高的兵工廠足球俱樂部（Arsenal FC）隊徽雕塑。
阿聯酋航空與該足球隊保持著長期贊助關係，至今該航空公司擔任兵工廠足球俱樂部的合作夥伴已達20年。
根據本站歷史紀錄，阿聯酋工程公司此前曾推出 Material Futures Studio 計畫，邀請大學生將退役飛機材料重新設計為新產品。該項材料再利用行動亦連結至阿聯酋航空的機隊改裝計畫，對 219 架空中巴士 A380 與波音 777 客機進行全面翻新。

en.title: Emirates Recycles Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 Parts into Arsenal FC Badge Sculpture
en.summary: Emirates recycled Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 aircraft parts into an eight-foot Arsenal FC badge sculpture.
body: According to Simple Flying, Emirates has recycled components from Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 aircraft to create an eight-foot sculpture of the Arsenal FC crest.
The airline and the football team maintain a long-standing sponsorship, with Emirates now serving as an official partner of Arsenal FC for two decades.

According to AVWIRE historical records, Emirates Engineering previously launched the Material Futures Studio initiative, which challenged university students to reimagine retired aircraft materials and turn them into new products. The carrier's upcycling efforts link to a broader retrofit program to refurbish 219 Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 aircraft.

zh.title: 聯合航空與維珍航空引進星鏈網路提升滿意度
zh.summary: 聯合航空與維珍航空報告星鏈WiFi提升乘客滿意度；兩航企加速機隊鋪設
body: 根據最新公布的客戶滿意度資料，聯合航空（United Airlines）與維珍航空（Virgin Atlantic）在班機上引進 SpaceX 的星鏈（Starlink）機上 WiFi 系統後，均獲得更高的乘客滿意度評分。資料顯示，低軌道衛星網路的高速與低延遲特性，正顯著改寫航空業機上連線服務的競爭格局，並成為提升乘客搭乘體驗與品牌忠誠度的關鍵要素。
聯合航空在其 2026 年第二季度的營運報告中指出，配備星鏈網路系統的航班所獲得的 WiFi 客戶滿意度評分，是使用其他 WiFi 系統機型的兩倍以上。聯合航空表示，截至 7 月中旬，公司已在超過 450 架幹線及聯合快捷（United Express）客機上完成星鏈設備安裝，並預計在 2026 年底前將裝備規模擴大至近 1,000 架客機，創下自 2023 年以來的 WiFi 滿意度新高紀錄。
維珍航空亦提早推進其星鏈網路升級計畫。維珍航空於 5 月底前完成了旗下空中巴士 A350 全機隊的星鏈系統安裝工作，比原定時程提前了五個月。維珍航空的首條 A350 星鏈服務於 5 月正式啟用，由倫敦希斯洛機場飛往紐約甘迺迪國際機場的 VS153 航班率先搭載，營運至今顧客正面回饋顯著增加。
在完成空中巴士 A350 機隊的升級後，維珍航空計畫進一步將星鏈機上網路服務擴展至旗下的波音 787 與空中巴士 A330neo 機隊，目標是在 2027 年達成全機隊覆蓋。航空公司高層表示，隨著星鏈低軌衛星技術的導入，乘客在飛行過程中得以享受流暢的高速上網與串流服務，有效提升了整體飛航體驗。

en.title: United and Virgin Atlantic See Higher Satisfaction with Starlink WiFi
en.summary: United Airlines and Virgin Atlantic report higher customer satisfaction scores after introducing Starlink WiFi on flights.
body: According to newly released passenger satisfaction data, both United Airlines and Virgin Atlantic have achieved significantly higher customer approval scores after introducing SpaceX's Starlink inflight WiFi service across their commercial fleets. Industry analysis and customer feedback indicate that high-speed, low-latency connectivity delivered by low Earth orbit satellite networks is reshaping inflight communications and becoming a decisive factor in driving passenger loyalty and overall satisfaction.

United Airlines officially reported in its second-quarter 2026 operational results that flights equipped with Starlink achieved a WiFi customer satisfaction score more than twice as high as aircraft operating with the airline's other legacy WiFi systems. United further disclosed that it had successfully installed Starlink equipment on more than 450 mainline and United Express aircraft by mid-July, with plans to expand the installation to nearly 1,000 equipped aircraft by the end of 2026.

Virgin Atlantic has also accelerated its fleet-wide Starlink technology rollout schedule. The British long-haul carrier completed the installation of Starlink connectivity systems across its entire fleet of Airbus A350 aircraft by the end of May, achieving full fleet implementation five months ahead of its initial schedule. Virgin Atlantic officially introduced its first Starlink-equipped Airbus A350 passenger service in May on flight VS153 operating from London Heathrow Airport to New York JFK Airport.

Following the completion of its Airbus A350 fleet retrofits, Virgin Atlantic now plans to extend Starlink satellite WiFi services to its Boeing 787 and Airbus A330neo aircraft fleets, aiming to achieve full fleet coverage by 2027. Airline executives noted that the deployment of low Earth orbit satellite connectivity allows passengers to stream content and perform high-bandwidth online tasks that previous generations of satellite networks struggled to sustain.

zh.title: 阿帕契直升機飛抵海巡署 參與漢光演習分散部署演練
zh.summary: 國軍阿帕契直升機飛抵海巡署；參與漢光演習分散部署；張忠龍視導起降順利
body: 國軍一架阿帕契直升機於2026年8月10日上午10時特別飛抵海洋委員會海巡署，執行漢光42號實兵演習的「分散部署演練」課目，並於上午11時30分離場，起降過程均順利完成。
海巡署署長張忠龍親自到場視導本次聯合演練。海巡署指出，演習目的在於持續深化海巡與國軍單位的協同作業默契，並提升臨戰應變效能。
國軍漢光42號實兵演習自8月5日至14日進行為期10天9夜的演練，8月10日進入第6天。各地區分署當天亦配合國軍執行據點防禦、側翼警戒、海上警戒及協助開設前進指揮所等演練項目。

en.title: Apache Helicopter Lands at Coast Guard Administration for Han Kuang Drill
en.summary: Taiwan military Apache helicopter lands at Coast Guard Administration for Han Kuang dispersed deployment drill.
body: A military Apache helicopter flew to Taiwan's Coast Guard Administration (CGA) at 10:00 a.m. on August 10, 2026, to conduct a dispersed deployment drill as part of the Han Kuang 42 live-fire exercise. The helicopter departed at 11:30 a.m. after completing its landing and takeoff smoothly.

CGA Director-General Chang Chung-long inspected the joint drill on site. According to the administration, the exercise was designed to deepen tactical coordination and emergency response between coast guard units and the armed forces.

The live-fire portion of Han Kuang 42 runs from August 5 to August 14 for 10 days and 9 nights, reaching its sixth day on August 10. Regional CGA branches also executed defensive tasks, including blockhouse defense, flank guarding, and command post establishment.
